heading: Never miss a moment.
subheading: Find what is on near you, see who is going and stay in the loop on the day.
details: Become one of our attendees and never miss what's happening near you. Search events by date, district, category or price, and see which of your friends are going. Join the event chat and open the venue map on the day, so you know where to be.

cards.title: Discover events
cards.point: Explore events by category, date, district and price.

cards.point: See which friends are attending and connect with other attendees.

cards.title: Live event updates
cards.point: Stay informed with event announcements, discussions and updates.
